problem: VAN: STATUS_SB_POLICY / VAN Restriction 1 - Secure Boot policy could not be verified (May-June 2026 wave)
symptoms: Vanguard says secure boot policy could not be verified; DB must be factory default
Happens although UEFI + Secure Boot enabled, keys reset, clean Windows reinstall
Works on another account/PC but not the main account
root_causes: Vanguard-side bug after the May 15 2026 update for some BIOS/devices (e.g. Surface Book 2)
Temporary hardware (HWID) restriction on the PC/account lasting about a month
Secure Boot DB not 'Factory' / outdated Windows UEFI CA 2023 certs

fixes.fix: Wait for Riot's small client patch (25.3 MB update on May 19 fixed it for one Surface Book 2 user) and re-launch; open a Riot support ticket naming the device model so they patch it

Contact Riot support to check for a ~1 month hardware/HWID restriction; waiting until the stated end date made the game work again (triggers cited: old BIOS, VMware/VPN/third-party software, outdated secure boot keys)
Check Windows Security > Device security for the Secure Boot certificate update status; Riot support told users in Discord there was no user-side fix at the time

diagnostic_signals: msinfo32 BIOS mode UEFI / Secure Boot State
Windows Security > Device security cert status
BIOS secure boot key type (Factory vs External/Custom)

problem: Secure Boot cannot be enabled / keys 'External' not 'Factory' / boot blocked by security policy
symptoms: Enabling Secure Boot gives red screen 'invalid signature'/black screen/'Windows Boot Manager has been blocked by the current security policy'
Windows does not boot with Secure Boot on; Secure Boot turns itself off after a Windows update
Vanguard requires Factory keys
root_causes: Secure Boot DB keys changed from Factory to External, outdated Windows UEFI CA 2023 certs
EFI partition boot files corrupted/misaligned after Windows update (KB5094135 on ASRock B450 reported)
Outdated BIOS/system not up to date

fixes.fix: In BIOS Key Management set Factory Key Provision=Enabled, Restore DB defaults, Install default Secure Boot Keys; then in WinRE Command Prompt (shutdown /r /o /f /t 0) run 'mountvol Z: /S' then bcdboot C:\Windows to rebuild the EFI boot files; bcdedit /enum all only if duplicate boot entries

Run PowerShell (admin) ([System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString((Get-SecureBootUEFI db).bytes) -match 'Windows UEFI CA 2023'); if False update Windows/BIOS and the Secure Boot certificates via Windows Security > Device security, then reset BIOS keys to Factory
Bring Windows and BIOS fully up to date (fixed VAN 9003 on a new Lenovo Ideapad)
Clean reinstall of Windows (fixed secure boot not booting on ASRock X570 / Ryzen 7 5700X)
Switch from Windows 11 to Windows 10 on a board without Secure Boot/TPM2 support (otherwise replace motherboard)
Update BIOS and reinstall OS using Rufus with the 2023 CA security certificate option for bootloader (suggested for Legion Slim 5 blocked boot manager)

diagnostic_signals: msinfo32 Secure Boot State and BIOS Mode
Windows Update KB installed date vs Secure Boot turning off

problem: VAN9005 - TPM 2.0/VBS requirement on old CPU/Windows 10
symptoms: Error says TPM 2.0 and UEFI firmware needed for Virtualization-based Security on i5-3330 Windows 10
root_causes: Hypervisor/VBS launch conflicting with unsupported hardware

fixes.fix: Run 'bcdedit /set hypervisorlaunchtype off' in an admin cmd (OP confirmed it worked)

problem: VAN Restriction - HVCI (Memory Integrity) required on flagged account
symptoms: Message: account does not meet requirements: HVCI enabled
Memory Integrity will not turn on, 'incompatible drivers' list empty
Happens on main account only; another account plays fine
root_causes: Account flagged as suspicious needs Memory Integrity (permanent for that account)
Incompatible drivers or virtualization (SVM/VT-x/VT-d/IOMMU) off in BIOS

fixes.fix: Core isolation > Memory integrity On and reboot; if unavailable enable SVM Mode (AMD) / VT-x + VT-d (Intel) in BIOS
Remove apps that install incompatible drivers (e.g. Huawei HiSuite/mobile wifi) then enable memory integrity; toggling IOMMU off with VT-d on let it persist for one user
OP fixed by running step-by-step command-prompt commands including deleting hidden/old driver packages until Memory integrity could be enabled

problem: VAN: STATUS_VMD_9001 - VMD controller fatal error
symptoms: VMD controller fatal unrecoverable error on Alienware; cannot switch to AHCI, system won't boot
root_causes: Riot-side Vanguard issue suspected; Intel VMD/RAID mode

fixes.fix: No fix; commenters concluded it is on Riot's side, OP filed support ticket

diagnostic_signals: Intel VMD controller / storage mode in BIOS (RAID vs AHCI)

problem: VAN 185 - disconnect / client crash in background (network, thermal, power)
symptoms: Kicked mid-match with VAN 185, stuck on loading screen after
Error 43 on EU while VAN 185 on APAC account
Occurs on first match and fixed by reboot (laptop)
root_causes: DNS/IPv6/firewall rules blocking Riot Client/Vanguard
CPU overheating (95C) making Vanguard fail to process
Windows update preceding

fixes.fix: Change DNS (e.g. 8.8.8.8/8.8.4.4) - OP confirmed fix for VAN185 after Windows update
Allow Riot Client, VALORANT, Vanguard in Windows Firewall inbound rules; disable IPv6 on adapter; set DNS to 8.8.8.8 / 8.8.4.4
Lower CPU heat: in Power Options > advanced > Processor power management reduce max processor state (laptop at 95C); also repaste CPU

problem: Vanguard / Play button loop, 'Preparing download', update button does nothing, Installing Vanguard loop
symptoms: Click Play -> 'Updating'/'Preparing download' then returns to Play
Update button loads then returns
Vanguard keeps installing on each launch
Play button does nothing with no error
Stuck on loading screen after crash
root_causes: Corrupted Riot/Vanguard install, auto-update bug, network/ISP problem, RiotClientServices compatibility

fixes.fix: Set RiotClientServices.exe (C:\Riot Games\Riot Client) Compatibility > Run in compatibility mode for Windows 8, apply and restart (Play button does nothing)
Riot Client profile > Settings > turn off 'Enable auto-update' (optionally repair) when Update button loops
End Riot Client in Task Manager, use a VPN (Psiphon) and launch Riot Client as admin then click Play; afterwards works without VPN after PC restart
Check Windows Security protection history and unblock blocked Valorant 'root cert' entries
Uninstall Vanguard only (Riot Client detects it missing) and let it reinstall automatically; fixed Riot client not launching VALORANT
Reinstall the game / delete Valorant and Riot Games and reinstall (loop, Section suspension misfire)
Close Vanguard user-mode service (vgc) in Task Manager then launch Valorant (stuck on loading after crash)

diagnostic_signals: Windows Defender protection history for blocked Riot certs

problem: Download stuck / client error needing network exceptions (Riot Client, VAL 62, VAN 102/VAL 5)
symptoms: Download stalls after a minute, resumes after pause
Recurring Riot client error
VAL 62 on wifi but ok on hotspot
Random kicks VAN 102/VAL 5
root_causes: ISP/route blocking Riot, firewall blocks, conflicting overlay/remapper apps

fixes.fix: Use a free VPN/Cloudflare WARP (WRAP VPN, Cloudflare) - fixed VAL 62 and stuck download
Add Riot Client, Vanguard user-mode service and VALORANT BootstrapPackagedGame to Windows Firewall allow rules for private and public networks
Close Steam, Discord, Logitech G HUB, x360ce/reWASD and overlays; flush DNS, reset Winsock/TCP-IP (community batch script)
Valorant unavailable in Iran: used VPN to log in

diagnostic_signals: conflicting apps running (Steam, Discord, G HUB, reWASD)

problem: Application failed to start - side-by-side configuration is incorrect
symptoms: Popup on launch and on uninstall: side-by-side configuration is incorrect
root_causes: Broken Microsoft Visual C++ redistributables (likely; fix not stated)

fixes.fix: OP said 'got it fixed' (fix not stated in thread)

problem: AMD driver crash - Valorant freezes, black screens, GPU driver disabled (AMD 26.5.x driver, May 2026)
symptoms: Freeze 2-5 min after launch, all monitors black
'A D3D11 compatible GPU is required' and Adrenaline must be reinstalled
Windows falls back to basic display driver
root_causes: AMD Adrenaline driver released May 6 2026 (and 26.3.1+ in another report); Windows 10 on some systems; iGPU disabled in BIOS

fixes.fix: Roll back to an older Adrenaline version (March 2026), turn off Adrenaline auto-update and Windows driver auto update
Enable integrated graphics (iGPU) to Auto in BIOS even if unused
Instead of reinstalling Adrenaline, disable then enable the GPU in Device Manager
Upgrade Windows 10 to Windows 11 (fixed for one 7900XTX user after rollbacks failed)
Roll back NVIDIA driver (552.22) to fix huge latency counter / monitors turning off

diagnostic_signals: GPU driver version and install date

problem: Valorant on wrong display output or wrong GPU selected
symptoms: Game does not start after moving or update; stuck on integrated GPU
root_causes: Monitor plugged into motherboard output; Windows chose integrated GPU

fixes.fix: Plug monitor into the dedicated GPU DisplayPort/HDMI (OP confirmed) and set Windows Graphics settings > Valorant to high performance GPU

problem: Whole-PC freeze / stutter when playing - USB selective suspend, MSI Afterburner, Bluetooth software, Realtek NIC
symptoms: Game and Windows lock up for seconds-minutes, vgm.exe in Event Viewer
Freeze at every click
Freeze when tabbing/text chat for a year
Micro stutters/ FPS drops every ~30s
root_causes: USB selective suspend; MSI Afterburner running; outdated WIDCOMM Bluetooth software; Realtek PCIe GbE controller hardware IO error (AMD boards + fTPM)

fixes.fix: Power Options > Advanced > USB settings > USB selective suspend = Disabled (or move keyboard/mouse to other USB ports)
Exit MSI Afterburner
Uninstall outdated Bluetooth software (WIDCOMM) found via Event Viewer
Realtek GbE adapter Advanced: Interrupt Moderation, Energy Efficient Ethernet, Green Ethernet, Flow Control, Large Send Offload v2 -> Disabled; speed 1Gbps Full Duplex
Update/older Realtek driver (10.x or 11.x 'not support power saving'); or disable adapter / use another NIC (Intel/Marvell)

diagnostic_signals: Event Viewer Realtek PCIe GbE errors / TPM Event ID 14

problem: PC crash/BSOD/restart with Valorant (PAGE_FAULT_IN_NONPAGED_AREA, KMODE, boot failure after Vanguard reboot)
symptoms: BSOD 5-40s into match
PC reboots without warning
Blue screen on boot after Vanguard restart
Complete PC freeze on Dell laptops with vgk.sys (SGX/Hyper-V)
root_causes: Stale 392667600.dat, Fast Startup, corrupted Windows files

fixes.fix: Delete C:\Windows\392667600.dat, disable Fast Startup (Power buttons > Turn on fast startup unchecked), restart, run Valorant as admin (Riot support approved)
Boot to recovery cmd and run chkdsk and sfc /scannow /offbootdir=X:\ /offwindir=D:\Windows to repair corrupted files (one user still stuck)

problem: Vanguard-caused FPS drops / low client FPS (vgc.exe CPU)
symptoms: Low Client FPS, frame drops after WiFi card replacement, FPS fall after update
High peaks and low drops on laptop
root_causes: vgc.exe maxing CPU (possibly because Vanguard treats new Wi-Fi card as DMA device); dusty laptop fans/thermals

fixes.fix: Task Manager > Details > vgc.exe > Set affinity: uncheck CPU 0 and keep a single other core (repeat each launch or use Process Lasso)
Clean fans (dust) on gaming laptop

symptoms: Monitor stays 1440p60 when game says 1080p120
Black bars with stretched res
Valorant reverts native res
No GPU scaling on Intel iGPU external monitor
root_causes: Scaling handled by display/GPU, Valorant fill vs windowed

fixes.fix: Create custom resolution with CRU after disabling monitor in Device Manager (guide)
Toggle V-Sync on monitor OSD on/off
Dragodraki GPU scaling registry tool + CRU for Intel iGPU external monitor

symptoms: Bluetooth headset not working
mic disabled after update
crackling static
root_causes: Mic input conflicts; updated 2026 audio driver

fixes.fix: Disable built-in microphone in Sound > Recording (keep playback on)
Install older 2024 audio driver
Cap FPS at 120 and use rear audio jack

diagnostic_signals: audio devices and default recording device

problem: High ping / lag or desync after changes
symptoms: Ping rose from 30-50 to 65ms
bullets not registering
enemies seem to kill before visible
root_causes: Wi-Fi congestion on 2.4GHz
network issues

fixes.fix: Use 5GHz or ethernet, check wifi analyzer; Riot Support suggested VPN
Clear standby list with RamMap, install VC++ 2015-2022 v14.40.33816 x64/x86, set Riot port forwarding with fixed LAN IP (OP: worked)
One OP reported fixing a 'weird network issue' without details

problem: False bans/suspensions and account feature errors
symptoms: Section 7 suspensions, VAN 1067 after 3 minutes, chat/friend list missing
root_causes: Unknown/server side

fixes.fix: Restart PC after each game update (VAN 1067)
